verses.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच । ततो दुर्योधनो राजा ज्ञात्वा तेषां वचस्तदा । चिरमन्तर्मना भूत्वा प्रत्युवाच सभासदः ॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Thereupon hearing their words, the king Duryodhana thought in his mind and then said to his courtiers.

verses.sanskrit: सुदुःखा खलु कार्याणां गतिर्विज्ञातुमन्ततः । तस्मात् सर्वे निरीक्षध्वं क्क नु ते पाण्डवा गताः ॥२॥
verses.english: It is very difficult to ascertain definitely the tide of affairs. Do you all ascertain where the Pandavas have gone.

verses.sanskrit: अल्पावशिष्टं कालस्य गतभूयिष्ठमन्ततः । तेषामज्ञातचर्यायामस्मिन् वर्षे त्रयोदशे ॥३॥
verses.english: Of these thirteen years which they have to pass hidden from us all, the greater portion has well-high elapsed and only a little remains.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य वर्षस्य शेषं चेद्व्यतीयुरिहः पाण्डवाः । निवृत्तसमयास्ते हि सत्यव्रतपरायणाः ॥४॥
verses.english: And if they can truly pass the remaining portion of this year hidden from our view in pursuance of their vow they will then have fulfilled their pledge.

verses.sanskrit: क्षरन्त इव नागेन्द्राः सर्वे ह्याशीविषोपमाः । दुःखा भवेयुः संरब्धाः कौरवान् प्रति ते ध्रुवम् ॥५॥
verses.english: Forsooth, they, worked up with anger, will torment the Kauravas like the elephants in rut or virulent snakes.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे कालस्य वेत्तारः कृच्छ्ररूपधराः स्थिताः । प्रविशेयुर्जितक्रोधास्तावदेव पुनर्वनम् ॥६॥
verses.english: Let them, with anger controlled, acquainted with all seasons, living in painful disguise, enter the woods again.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् क्षिप्रं बुभूषध्वं यथा तेऽत्यन्तमव्ययम् । राज्यं निर्द्वन्द्वमव्यग्रं निःसपत्नं चिरं भवेत् ॥७॥
verses.english: Do you all concert measures speedily for this, so that our kingdom may remain without enemies, rivals and diminution.
verses.bhavadeepa: यथा ते पुनर्वनं प्रविशेयुस्तथा बुभूषध्वं तान् प्राप्तुमिच्छतेत्यर्थः ॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: अथाब्रवीत्ततः कर्णः क्षिप्रं गच्छन्तु भारत । अन्ये धूर्ता नरा दक्षा निभृताः साधुकारिणः ॥८॥
verses.english: Thereupon Karna said : “O descendant of Bharata, let other spies, more, cunning, capable and better fitted for this work, proceed in disguise.

verses.sanskrit: चरन्तु देशान् संवीताः स्फीताञ्जनपदाकुलान् । तत्र गोष्ठीषु रम्यासु सिद्धप्रव्रजितेषु च ॥९॥
verses.english: Let them range all over the country, various provinces over-flowing with population, assemblies of learned men and charming retreats of ascetics.

verses.sanskrit: परिचारेषु तीर्थेषु विविधेष्वाकरेषु च । विज्ञातव्या मनुष्यैस्तैस्तर्कया सुविनीतया ॥१०॥
verses.english: In inner apartments, places of pilgrimage, mines and various other places (they should be searched after) with vigilance and humility.
verses.bhavadeepa: जनपदाकुलान् जनव्याप्तान् । ‘भवेज्जनपदो जानपदोऽपि जनदेशयोः’ इति मेदिनी । गोष्ठीषु विद्वत्सभासु सिद्धानां प्रव्रजितं गमनीयेषु तेषु मुनीनामाश्रमेषु ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: विविधैस्तत्परैः सम्यक् तज्ज्ञैर्निपुणसंवृतैः । अन्वेष्टव्याः सुनिपुणैः पाण्डवाश्छन्नवासिनः ॥११॥
verses.english: The Pandavas, living in disguise, should be searched after by a number of expert spies, devoted to this work, themselves disguised and well acquainted with the object of search.
verses.bhavadeepa: परि आगत्य चरन्त्येषु ते परिचाराः राजपुराणि । तेषु तर्कया कांक्षया ‘तर्कः कांक्षावितर्केहि’ इति मेदिनी ॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: आश्रमेषु च रम्येषु पर्वतेषु गुहासु च । नदीकुञ्जेषु तीर्थेषु ग्रामेषु नगरेषु च ॥१२॥
verses.english: On the banks of the rivers, in sacred shrines, villages, cities, hermitages, charming mountains and caves.

verses.sanskrit: अथाग्रजानन्तरजः पापभावानुरागवान् । ज्येष्ठं दुःशासनस्तत्र भ्राता भ्रातरमब्रवीत् ॥१३॥
verses.english: Thereupon his younger brother Dushasana, taking delight in sins, said before his elder brother.

verses.sanskrit: येषु नः प्रत्ययो राजंश्चारेषु मनुजाधिप । ते यान्तु दत्तदेया वे भूयस्तान् परिमार्गितुम् ॥१४॥
verses.english: O king, O lord of men, let those spies, in whom we have confidence, receive their remuneration in advance and proceed in search of them.

verses.sanskrit: एतच्च कर्णो यत्प्राह सर्वमीहामहे तथा । यथोद्दिष्टं चराः सर्वे मृगयन्तु यतस्ततः ॥१५॥
verses.english: This and what Karna has said have my full approbation. As directed let all those spies search at all those places.

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च भूयांसो देशाद्देशं यथाविधि । न तु तेषां गतिर्वासः प्रवृत्तिश्चोपलभ्यते ॥१६॥
verses.english: Let those and others make a due search in various countries. My belief is that their movements and whereabouts are not to be known.

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तं वा निगूढास्ते पारं चोर्मिमतो गताः। व्यालैश्चापि महारण्ये भक्षिताः शूरमानिनः ॥१७॥
verses.english: They are living in very great secrecy; or perhaps they have gone to the other side of the ocean. Those respecters of heroes might have been devoured by wild animals in that huge forest.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा विषमं प्राप्य विनष्टाः शाश्वतीः समाः । तस्मान्मानसमव्यग्रं कृत्वा त्वं कुरुनन्दन । कुरु कार्यं महोत्साहं मन्यसे यन्नराधिप ॥१८॥
verses.english: Or overtaken by some dreadful calamity, they have perished for ever. Therefore, O Kuru chief, removing all anxiety from your heart, acquire what you may, working with your energy, O king.
